headline: Commanders' Terry McLaurin carted off field with knee injury, ruled out for MNF
summary: Commanders wide receiver Terry McLaurin was carted off the field with his left leg in an air cast after injuring his knee in the first quarter of Monday night's game against the 49ers.

headline: Rams suffer several major injuries, including to WR Adams, who's out 6-10 weeks
summary: Rams wideout Davante Adams ruptured a hamstring in Sunday's loss to the Cardinals, and he will be sidelined for six to 10 weeks, coach Sean McVay announced.

headline: 49ers rule out Mike Evans due to Achilles injury
summary: Niners receiver Mike Evans was ruled out of Monday night's game vs. the Commanders because of an Achilles injury.

headline: Texans WR Tank Dell To Play In Week 7

headline: NFL suspends Bills' C.J. Gardner-Johnson for one game for spitting
summary: The NFL has suspended Bills safety C.J. Gardner-Johnson for one game after cameras captured him spitting toward Raiders players on Sunday.
